<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if ( get_option( 'sportsarena_local_ready' ) ) {
	return;
}
// Arabic site language: download the WordPress language pack (needs internet),
// otherwise store the locale directly (the theme and plugin are Arabic already).
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/translation-install.php';
if ( ! in_array( 'ar', get_available_languages(), true ) ) {
	wp_download_language_pack( 'ar' );
}
if ( in_array( 'ar', get_available_languages(), true ) ) {
	update_option( 'WPLANG', 'ar' );
} else {
	global $wpdb;
	$wpdb->replace( $wpdb->options, array( 'option_name' => 'WPLANG', 'option_value' => 'ar', 'autoload' => 'yes' ) );
	wp_cache_flush();
}
update_option( 'blogname', 'ساحة الرياضة' );
update_option( 'blogdescription', 'نتائج ومواعيد المباريات لحظة بلحظة' );
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );
update_option( 'timezone_string', 'UTC' );

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if ( get_option( 'sportsarena_local_ready' ) || ! class_exists( 'SportsArena\Core\Seeder' ) ) {
	return;
}
$settings                = (array) get_option( 'sportsarena_settings', array() );
$settings['allow_logos'] = 1;
$settings['site_names']  = "en=Sports Arena|Live scores and fixtures, minute by minute\nfr=Sports Arena|Résultats et calendrier des matchs en direct";
update_option( 'sportsarena_settings', $settings );
SportsArena\Core\Seeder::seed();
flush_rewrite_rules();
update_option( 'sportsarena_local_ready', 1 );
